sites.name: Șoseaua Balcani (M1/E581) twin viaducts over Drum de acces Pruncu + Bîc channel (SW) and Visterniceni-Ghidighici railway (NE), Calea Ieșilor/Pruncu interchange

bridges.road: Șoseaua Balcani, NW (eastbound) carriageway - SW bridge
bridges.evidence: Data spans match OSM man_made=bridge outlines 1144610339-342 (deck extents) and current Google satellite (twin decks, paved conical abutment slopes in the gap between the SW and NE bridges, regulated concrete-lined Bîc channel + Drum de acces Pruncu passing under the SW bridge, railway under the NE bridge). Esri img/s0.jpg (old, single deck) and img/s0wide.jpg (construction of the channel). Heights: no Google 3D/Street-View-car coverage under the bridge; deck derived from clearance rules + DEM where approaches meet natural ground: junction with Calea Ieșilor/Pruncu ramps at grade at s=-300 (DEM -37.3), road under at DEM -40.3 needs >=5.5 m clearance + 1.3 m deck -> deck >= -33.5; rail (DEM along rail -35.3 interpolated) needs 6.5 m + 1.3 -> deck >= -27.7 at s=60; NE approach meets hillside DEM at s~200 (-21.4). Grade 4.5% between. ESTIMATE +-1.5 m. A user photosphere on the gap embankment reports alt 54 m (=-32.2 game, deck-road ~-34) vs this profile -30.4: GPS altitude, low weight. s = metres along axis (-4034,-3284)->(-3896,-3401) from centre (-3965,-3342.5). Pier positions ESTIMATED.

sites.name: R6 Chișinău–Orhei (E584) twin overpass over the Bucovinei link/loop road (Chișinău Arena interchange)

bridges.evidence: Street View (photo path Aug 2025) from the road under, 75 m W (47.07085,28.85840) and 85 m E (47.07046,28.86049): classic precast-beam twin overpass, 3 spans, piers at the road edges, abutments on grassed/paved cone slopes; the road under runs in a CUTTING (banks rise to deck level beside it), nearly at grade 85 m east, ~3 m cut 75 m west where the loop ramp climbs.
